derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and a derivative of G473 (ἀντί);
def: to meet with; figuratively, to occur

occurrences.text: And it came to pass, that on the next day, when they were come down from the hill, much people met him.
And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.
And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him.
And now, behold, I go bound in the spirit unto Jerusalem, not knowing the things that shall befall me there:
For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;
For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.
